description:
Minimize windows to the system tray (notification) area


[Finestray-0.5-win64.exe](https://github.com/benbuck/finestray/releases/download/v0.5/Finestray-0.5-win64.exe) is the installer.

[Finestray.exe](https://github.com/benbuck/finestray/releases/download/v0.5/Finestray.exe) is the standalone portable executable.
